bio:
I am a software engineer and student researcher driven by the synergy between resilient backend architectures, intuitive human interfaces, and applied artificial intelligence.

Over the past few years, I have architected high-concurrency microservices, contributed to open-source developer toolchains, and engineered production-grade vector search platforms. When I'm not writing code, I mentor aspiring developers, lead hackathons, and research distributed consensus algorithms.
availability: Available for Summer 2026 Internships & High-Impact Engineering Roles
